categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches `src/common/bip352.cpp`, which implements shared cryptographic and protocol primitives for BIP-352 silent payments.
categories.rationale: Fixes a cryptographic correctness bug in silent payment input key aggregation that silently corrupts derived shared secrets. Inputs spending arbitrary P2SH scripts or malformed witness stacks could be erroneously identified as eligible silent payment inputs, corrupting the input hash and shared secret calculation.
